name: Check whether a report can be appealed
description: Check whether a report can be appealed Returns whether the report is currently appealable, along with the signals behind that decision: whether it already has an open appeal, how many appeals have been submitted against it, and whether it has at least one mitigation that an appeal could reverse. GET /client/v4/account…
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/{report_id}/appeals/eligibility
Returns whether the report is currently appealable, along with the signals behind that decision: whether it already has an open appeal, how many appeals have been submitted against it, and whether it has at least one mitigation that an appeal could reverse.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID; report_id (path) — Abuse Report ID

name: List abuse reports
description: List abuse reports List the abuse reports for a given account GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports
List the abuse reports for a given account
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID
Optional: page (query) — Where in pagination to start listing abuse reports; per_page (query) — How many abuse reports per page to list; sort (query) — A property to sort by, followed by the order (id, cdate, domain, type, status); domain (query) — Filter by domain name related to the abuse report; created_before (query) — Returns reports created before the specified date; created_after (query) — Returns reports created after the specified date; status (query) — Filter by the status of the report.; type (query) — Filter by the type of the report.; mitigation_status (query) — Filter reports that have any mitigations in the given status.

name: List abuse report emails
description: List abuse report emails List emails sent to the customer for an abuse report. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/{report_id}/emails
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/{report_id}/emails
List emails sent to the customer for an abuse report. Returns all successful customer emails sent for the specified abuse report. Does not include emails sent to hosts or submitters.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID; report_id (path) — Abuse Report ID
Optional: page (query) — Page number to retrieve (default 1); per_page (query) — Number of emails per page (default 20, max 100)

name: List abuse report mitigations
description: List abuse report mitigations List mitigations done to remediate the abuse report. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/{report_id}/mitigations
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/{report_id}/mitigations
List mitigations done to remediate the abuse report.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID; report_id (path) — Abuse Report ID
Optional: page (query) — Where in pagination to start listing abuse reports; per_page (query) — How many abuse reports per page to list; sort (query) — A property to sort by, followed by the order; type (query) — Filter by the type of mitigation. This filter parameter can be specified multiple times to include multiple types of mitigations in the result set.; effective_before (query) — Returns mitigations that were dispatched before the given date; effective_after (query) — Returns mitigation that were dispatched after the given date; status (query) — Filter by the status of the mitigation.; entity_type (query) — Filter by the type of entity the mitigation impacts.

name: List emails sent to an abuse report submitter
description: List emails sent to an abuse report submitter List successful emails sent to the submitter of a report submitted by the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/submitted/{report_id}/emails
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/submitted/{report_id}/emails
List successful emails sent to the submitter of a report submitted by the account. Does not include emails sent to customers or hosts.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID; report_id (path) — Public report code.
Optional: page (query) — Page number to retrieve (default 1).; per_page (query) — Number of emails per page (default 20, max 100).

name: List submitted abuse reports
description: List submitted abuse reports List abuse reports submitted by the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/submitted
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/submitted
List abuse reports submitted by the account.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID
Optional: page (query) — Page of submitted reports to return.; per_page (query) — Number of submitted reports per page.; sort (query) — A property and direction to sort by (id, cdate, domain, type, status).; id (query) — Filter by report code.; domain (query) — Filter by reported domain. This parameter can be specified multiple times.; created_before (query) — Return reports submitted before this time.; created_after (query) — Return reports submitted after this time.; status (query) — Filter by submitter-facing status. This parameter can be specified multiple times.; type (query) — Filter by report type. This parameter can be specified multiple times.

name: Request review on mitigations
description: Request review on mitigations Request a review for mitigations on an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/{report_id}/mitigations/appeal
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/abuse-reports/{report_id}/mitigations/appeal
Request a review for mitigations on an account. Repeating a request for a mitigation with an unresolved appeal is idempotent and returns that mitigation in the in-review state.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID; report_id (path) — Abuse Report ID; body (body)
